name: Marketing & Customer Retention
summary: Win back lapsed customers, reward loyalty, and keep repeat business coming in on its own.
description: Keeping a customer costs far less than finding a new one, but retention work is easy to postpone because nothing visibly breaks when you skip it. These automations run the campaigns that quietly drive repeat revenue: win-back sequences, renewal reminders, referral rewards, birthday offers, and launch announcements. Each one is triggered by real customer behavior instead of a calendar reminder someone forgets to check.
